scene_sentence_zh: 赤色砂岩的巨大拱門橫跨乾燥隘口，正午的強光把門內的通道照得發白。

license.terms: Original artwork generated for this repository by its maintainers and committed with the project; it may be redistributed under the project's own repository terms. No third-party stock imagery, scraped artwork, or externally licensed asset is included.

production.method: sd-webui txt2img through the repository's internal client (world.art.sd_worker.SDWebUIClient.generate) using the shipped prompt library, then local WebP encoding through world.art.formats.encode
production.description: a towering natural arch of banded red sandstone spanning a dry pass, wind-polished curves and dusty ledges, hard noon light and a hot haze at the horizon, a bare trodden track running straight through the opening and open gravel on this side of it

visual_review.native_scale: Reviewed at native 1536x864: A painterly JRPG natural arch of banded red sandstone spanning a dry pass, wind-polished curves and dusty ledges, noon haze at the horizon and a trodden track running straight through the opening over open gravel. No figure, no creature, no readable lettering; the arch frames the upper two thirds over the open approach.
visual_review.desktop_cover_crop: Reviewed under the desktop 1451x790 cover crop: the full-bleed composition holds at 1451x790: the arch and its sky opening keep the upper band while the track and gravel stay clear below.
visual_review.contact_sheet: Reviewed on a ten-up contact sheet of the whole rite pack: each archetype reads as its own place — spring basin, stag statue, stone circle, sea tower, tree hollow, grave rows, crystal mine, sandstone arch, waterfall basin and capital plaza — with a consistent painterly palette and no two compositions alike.
